_why: Every critical or high Snyk finding with no GitLab counterpart needs a decision here, with the reason a reviewer can check. migrate.py fails the gate on any that has none, and on any decision left behind once its gap is gone.

accepted_gaps.reason: GitLab's default Python ruleset does not report Flask returning command output as reflected XSS (CWE-79); Snyk Code does. The line is still a GitLab finding after the move, for command injection (CWE-78, bandit.B602), so it is not invisible; its XSS facet is. Reporting that facet needs a custom SAST ruleset, an Ultimate feature this repository does not exercise.
